integrity: Complete finite elementary proof based on derangement recurrences, exact binomial identity, Lucas and Kummer; same-model review only.
scientific_limitations: Only odd moved-support and at least one fixed point are included; the zero derangement column at moved support one and the all-moved endpoint are excluded.
All selected two-adic valuations are classified, but the odd-prime valuations of individual selected entries are not.
Finite computation diagnoses examples only; it does not prove the infinite claim.
Unindexed equivalent previous results cannot be ruled out; no independent audit has been performed.
title: Exact gcd and binary minimum spectrum for odd-support rencontres rows
